pages.notes: Server-rendered SvelteKit index. 67446 of 144074 bytes are <script> (SvelteKit hydration payload) and 37321 bytes are inline <svg> (wordmark + icons), so the low text:HTML ratio reflects markup weight, not an empty shell. Measured.

var(--mono) = "Atlas Typewriter", Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, monospace

typography.fontStacksNote: Three self-hosted families behind --sans / --serif / --mono. body uses --font-body which resolves to --serif; UI chrome (sticky bar, filters, kickers) uses --mono; headings inside .column-regular switch to --sans. All measured from @font-face + var() declarations.

fontSizeSystem.note: A px-named rem ladder is declared once on :root and everything else references it: --12px .75rem, --14px .875rem, --16px 1rem, --18px 1.125rem, --20px 1.25rem, --22px 1.375rem, --24px 1.5rem, --28px 1.75rem, --32px 2rem, --36px 2.25rem, --40px 2.5rem, --44px 2.75rem, --48px 3rem, --56px 3.5rem, --64px 4rem, --80px 5rem, --96px 6rem, --112px 7rem, --128px 8rem. Five fluid roles sit on top: --font-size-giant clamp(3rem,4vw,5rem), --font-size-large clamp(1.5rem,2.5vw,2.5rem), --font-size-medium clamp(1rem,1.75vw,1.5rem), --font-size-small clamp(15px,1.25vw,1rem), --font-size-xsmall clamp(12px,1vw,.8rem).

headingScale.ratioNote: Not a constant-ratio scale. Measured steps: 48/36 = 1.333, 36/28 = 1.286, 28/24 = 1.167, 24/22 = 1.091, 22/20 = 1.100. The scale is hand-picked off the px token ladder and compresses sharply at the small end. All six elements share font-weight:500 and margin:16px 0; .column-regular h2 overrides family to --sans and weight to 900.

bodyCandidates.fontSizeBasis: inferred: no font-size is declared on html, :root or body anywhere in the five stylesheets, so the UA default 16px stands and every rem token resolves against it. --16px = 1rem confirms the intended base.

typography.fluidTypeEvidence: measured: 13 clamp() occurrences and 17 vw lengths across the five stylesheets; five named --font-size-* roles and --padding are all clamp()-based.

spacing.evidence: measured from margin/padding/gap declarations. 16px (15x) and 8px (15x) dominate, then 24px/12px/32px (7x each), 4px/48px (5x), 64px (4x). Every high-frequency value is a multiple of 4 and most are multiples of 8; the only off-grid values are 10px (2x), 18px (1x) and 7px (1x), all in one-off component rules. --margin is declared as 16px and used as the standard gutter (.column-wide/.column-regular padding:0 16px). Vertical rhythm is 16px between block elements (h1-h6,p{margin:16px 0}) and 64px above section headings (.column-regular h2{margin-top:64px}).
spacing.fluidPaddingToken: --padding: clamp(16px, 12vw, 36px) (measured; declared but referenced by only one rule in the fetched sheets)

customProperties.name: --serif
customProperties.value: "Gooper SemiCondensed", Iowan Old Style, Times New Roman, Times, serif

color.customPropertiesNote: 93 custom properties were found on :root; the 80 recorded here are colour-like first, then the remaining scale/layout tokens. Full set is in raw/pudding_cool/css/0.C2Vp5USR.css.

palette.greyRamp: 11 steps: gray-50 rgb(247,247,247) → gray-1000 rgb(25,25,25), plus #000000/#ffffff. Measured.
palette.note: Accents are declared but the chrome is achromatic: --color-primary and --color-link both resolve to black in light mode. Green is reserved for --color-focus and yellow for --color-mark (<mark> highlight).

color.contrastRatioBasis: computed WCAG 2.x ratio for rgb(38,38,38) on #ffffff, both resolved from plain values through the token chain. Passes AAA.
color.darkModeContrastBasis: computed for rgb(239,239,239) (gray-100) on rgb(25,25,25) (gray-1000), the dark-mode --color-fg/--color-bg. Passes AAA.
color.darkModeEvidence: measured: @media screen and (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{…}} in 0.C2Vp5USR.css re-points 17 semantic tokens (--color-bg, --color-fg, --color-primary, --color-link, --color-link-hover, --color-secondary-gray, --color-border, --color-button-*, --color-input-*, --color-placeholder, --color-default-story-bg, --fade) at different steps of the same grey ramp. No class or data-attribute toggle and no theme-switch control exist in the markup, so dark mode follows the OS only and cannot be overridden by the reader. Two component sheets add their own prefers-color-scheme:dark blocks for form inputs.
color.focusColor: --color-focus: var(--color-electric-green) #3AE660, used as outline:2px solid with outline-offset:2px on button/a/input/select (measured)

layout.breakpointNote: measured. Mobile-first: 8 of 9 width queries are min-width. 960px is the primary desktop switch (4 min + 1 max); 400/600/720 handle card-grid density. 720px and 960px also appear as content widths (--width-column-regular / --width-column-wide), so the breakpoints are the column widths themselves.

nonWidthQueries.note: hover affordances gated to real pointers

layout.contentWidthNote: Two-tier measure: a 1280px wide container for the story grid and a 720px regular column for prose, both padded 16px. --width-padded 80vw / --margin-left 10vw and --width-padded-mobile 90vw / --margin-left-mobile 5vw are declared for story-page layouts but unused in the index sheets.

gridUsage.evidence: measured: 29 display:flex declarations (each paired with a -webkit-box fallback) and zero display:grid or grid-template-* declarations across all five stylesheets and zero inline display:grid in the markup. The story index is a flex-wrap layout with an autoprefixer-era -webkit-box fallback, not CSS Grid.

navigation.evidence: Structure counts from the saved markup: 1 nav, 1 header, 1 main, 1 footer, 0 aside. aria-label, aria-controls and aria-hidden are present (15 aria-* attributes); no role= attributes. 27 of 59 images carry loading="lazy"; none use srcset. Focus is styled explicitly (outline:2px solid --color-focus, offset 2px) with a :focus:not(:focus-visible) suppression for mouse users.

behaviours.name: off-canvas navigation drawer
behaviours.evidence: DOM: <nav id="nav-menu" aria-hidden="true"> paired with <button aria-label="open menu" aria-controls="nav-content">; CSS: position:fixed, visibility:hidden, transform:translate(100%), transition:transform var(--transition-medium). The aria-hidden flip and class toggle are done by the SvelteKit bundle at runtime.

behaviours.name: filter / faceted browsing
behaviours.evidence: A dedicated Filters.DX9ElI68.css component sheet with .filters--mobile select rules, plus 1 <select> and 5 <input> elements and 9 <button> elements in the markup. Client-side filtering of the story grid is implied by the component split, but the filtering code itself is in the JS bundle and was not fetched.

behaviours.name: email subscribe form
behaviours.evidence: input.email-input rules in Stories.E6MWasA7.css including prefers-color-scheme:dark placeholder overrides; subscribe sticker links in the nav.

behaviours.name: hover-tilt sticker interaction
behaviours.evidence: 34 :hover rule blocks and 24 transform:rotate() declarations, with --left-tilt -2deg / --right-tilt 2deg / --left-tilt-double -4deg / --right-tilt-double 4deg tokens. .sticker-set:hover rotates and scales its children. Gated by @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

behaviours.name: motion respects reduced-motion
behaviours.evidence: @media screen and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) wraps motion, and --1s is redefined as 1ms so every calc(var(--1s) * .25) transition (72 declarations) collapses to near-zero when motion is suppressed. This is an opt-in pattern: animation only runs when the reader has expressed no preference.

behaviours.name: lazy image loading
behaviours.evidence: 27 of 59 elements carry loading="lazy"; no srcset or , so responsive art direction is not used on the index.

behaviours.name: privacy-light analytics
behaviours.evidence: Single external script src="//gc.zgo.at/count.js" (GoatCounter). No tag manager, no consent banner markup, no cookie dialog in the fetched HTML.

behaviours.name: scroll-driven explanation
behaviours.evidence: NOT OBSERVED on the fetched page. The index carries no IntersectionObserver, scrollama, requestAnimationFrame, scroll listener, scroll-snap, scroll-behavior or @keyframes reference in its HTML or its five stylesheets, and there is no <canvas>. A Story.C1ahabKR.css component sheet exists and individual story pages were not fetched, so the site's scrollytelling lives there and is unmeasured here.

behaviours.name: command palette
behaviours.evidence: Not present. No dialog element, no keydown/hotkey hint, no palette markup.

behaviours.name: copy button
behaviours.evidence: Not present. No navigator.clipboard reference in the fetched HTML.

measurement.notes: Single page fetched: https://pudding.cool/ returned HTTP 200, 43832 bytes on the wire, 144074 bytes decompressed, saved to raw/pudding_cool/index.html. No bot challenge, no JS gate — the SvelteKit app is server-rendered and 3502 characters of visible text arrived in the HTML. Zero inline <style> blocks; all five <link rel=stylesheet> hrefs were resolved against https://pudding.cool/ and fetched at HTTP 200 (43898 bytes of CSS total). No @import in any sheet, so the stylesheet graph is complete. Every typographic, spacing, colour and layout value above is read from those files or from the saved markup; nothing is from a rendered browser. LIMITS: (1) no computed styles, so cascade winners at a given viewport and the resolved value of every clamp() are not verified; (2) only the index was fetched, so the scroll-driven story template that makes this site a reference is represented only by the presence of Story.C1ahabKR.css and is explicitly not measured; (3) --width-padded, --margin-left, --font-size-giant, --font-size-large and --padding are declared on :root but barely referenced in the index sheets, which suggests they belong to the unfetched story template; (4) font files were not downloaded, so Atlas Grotesk / Gooper SemiCondensed / Atlas Typewriter metrics are unknown; (5) the 27 h3 elements are story-card titles and the page has no h1, which is a real heading-order observation for the index but may not hold on story pages.

browserPass.tool: Claude Code Browser pane (Chromium), computed styles via javascript_tool
browserPass.notes: Desktop emulated at 1440x900. Index is a project grid; the reading column was measured on a scrollytelling story. Library detection is limited by external bundles — d3/scrollama/gsap/IntersectionObserver recorded as unknown, not absent.

measurement.partialReason: Layout, typography, colour, contrast, chrome, sticky stages and step counts are fully measured at both widths. Library attribution is not: both scripts are external bundles and no globals are exposed, so d3, scrollama, gsap and IntersectionObserver are recorded as unknown rather than absent.

pagesMeasured: https://pudding.cool/2026/07/essential-words (a scrollytelling story, used for the reading column)
measured.method: Chromium computed styles via javascript_tool. Desktop emulated at 1440x900 (the pane's own 'desktop' preset reports a 0x0 viewport); mobile at the 375x812 preset with a reload. Characters per line = paragraph content-box width / average glyph width of a 100-character lorem span in the paragraph's exact computed font styles.

homePage.h1AndH2Reason: The index renders no non-empty h1 or h2; project cards are h3.

sticky: nav 360x900 fixed at top:0, z 1001 — an off-canvas panel

homePage.note: The index is dark and set in a grotesk; the story is cream and set in a serif. The two surfaces share no typeface and invert the scheme.

readingColumn.maxWidthNote: The only reference in this set that declares its measure directly as max-width: 650px on the prose container, rather than letting a grid decide it.
readingColumn.note: 68 characters per line, inside the 45-75 range. The background is a warm cream rather than white, and the text is a mid grey rather than black.

contrast.note: 7.17:1 clears AAA by 0.17 — the narrowest AAA margin measured in this set, and the deliberate result of grey-on-cream rather than black-on-white.

headings.oneTypefaceRule: Every heading level and the body text are the same face (Tiempos Text) in the same colour (rgb(87,87,87)) at weights 400-500. The hierarchy is carried entirely by size and space, with no colour, weight-jump or face change.
headings.h1LineHeightNote: h1 line-height 69.6px on a 48px face is a ratio of 1.45 — looser than the body's 1.55 would predict for display type, and unusually airy for a title.
headings.spaceNote: h2 margin-top 80px is four times its margin-bottom (20px): sections are separated by a very large gap and the heading sits close to what follows.

stickyStages.note: A full-viewport sticky stage — the graphic pins while the reader scrolls past it.

chrome.note: There is no persistent header or nav over the story. The only sticky boxes are the graphic stages themselves — chrome is spent on the visualisation, not on navigation.

scrollytelling.mechanism: position: sticky stages plus 31 step elements. Measured, not inferred: both the sticky stages and the step count were read from computed style and the DOM.
scrollytelling.note: Zero <canvas>: the graphics are SVG, so they stay in the DOM and in the accessibility tree.

search.note: No search input on either the index or the story, and no <kbd> hint.

pageWeight.note: 37.31 screens is by far the longest page measured here — five times a typical article — because the scroll distance is the interaction, not just the text length.

readingColumn.maxWidthNote: The declared max-width changes from 650px to 343px — an explicit breakpoint value, not a percentage.
readingColumn.colorCaveat: The matched paragraph at this width computes rgb(70,70,70) where the desktop match computed rgb(87,87,87). Both are recorded as read; the story uses more than one grey for prose.

mobile.bodyStepsDown: 20px/31px becomes 18px/27.9px — the size drops but the 1.55 ratio is held exactly, and the 32px paragraph gap does not move.

h1.note: The title does not shrink at all: 48px on a 375px screen.

scrollytelling.evidence: A 343x748 sticky div classed 'intro-mobile-stage' appears at 375px in place of the desktop 'intro-stage'. The story ships a distinct mobile stage component rather than reflowing the desktop one.

inferred.svelteEvidence: Scoped class suffixes on live elements: 'text-wrapper svelte-147lxqr', 'intro-stage svelte-18aw0nf', 'svelte-1elx88z'. This is a compiled Svelte component tree, not a runtime framework signature.
inferred.libraryDetectionLimit: The story ships two scripts, both external bundles, and exposes no library globals (window.d3, window.scrollama, window.gsap all undefined). The name scan only covers script URLs and inline script text, so a bundled and minified d3 or scrollama would not appear. These four are recorded as unknown, not absent. What IS measured: the pinning is CSS position:sticky and there are 31 step elements and 9 SVG nodes.
inferred.colorSchemeNote: No declaration; the index is dark and the story is light by authored choice, not by preference query.
inferred.weightNote: Two scripts on a 37-screen interactive story is the lightest script count in this set alongside the index.

measured.partialReason: Layout, typography, colour, contrast, chrome, sticky stages and step counts are fully measured at both widths. Library attribution is not: both scripts are external bundles and no globals are exposed, so d3, scrollama, gsap and IntersectionObserver are recorded as unknown rather than absent.
